body_html:
Starting off with an early Friday afternoon wedding at the incredible Heritage Eagle Bend Golf Course was one incredible way to start the weekend. After the beautiful ceremony it was time to get the party started right. As we moved inside for the reception of the evening guests enjoyed cocktails while waiting for dinner. Although there was not an incredibly long period of dancing at the end of the night, this party definitely did not slow down until the last song finished. Keeping the dance floor packed for the evening, JAMMIN’ DJs once again provided Award Winning DJ Service

~Cameron Jackson~
